Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature to clarify `totalUsage`, did not add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry as required by the acceptance criteria, and left an artifact `.lore/dod.md` in the repository. While the acceptance tests themselves and the `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` update are well-structured and target the right behavior, the core implementation is missing.
